title: Certify Engine F3 reference implementation against the clause-capability ledger
description:
Family-level certification gate for engine:F3 (Active-effect, concentration, and owned-entity lifecycle). Feeds the overall
reference-engine certification under eshyra-olc5, which gates the SRD re-freeze.

Certify that:

  * Every authoritative-ledger member for engine:F3 is implemented, OR explicitly
    excluded under one of the four approved non-deterministic categories
    (campaign-ruling ambiguity, intentional model adjudication, external non-SRD
    content, explicitly deferred non-deterministic house rules).
  * Pack clauses and engine consumers use the SAME contract — the engine reads
    the committed pack representation, not a test fixture shaped to suit it.
  * Executable, source-backed conformance tests exercise the pack representation
    for each primitive in this family.
  * ZERO remaining pending capability references for this family in the
    authoritative ledger (eshyra-o9bd.19.5.12).
  * Finding-registry (eshyra-o9bd.19.1.6) evidence is attached for every finding
    this family closes, with the registry status recorded.
  * Replay / deterministic-equivalence tests and failure-boundary tests pass
    where applicable.
  * Unsupported input fails CLOSED — no silent degradation, no partial
    execution presented as complete.

*** engine:F* IS A QUALIFIED PREFIX. engine:F1..F10 are the pack's
executionReadiness engineHooks families — NOT the CLOSED epic eshyra-2n1t's
different F1-F10, and NOT the fable:F1..F8 audit findings.
acceptance_criteria:
• Zero pending capability references for engine:F3 in the authoritative ledger.
• Every member implemented or explicitly excluded under a named approved category.
• Pack-driven (not fixture-driven) conformance tests pass for every primitive.
• Finding-registry evidence attached for each finding closed by this family.
• Fail-closed and replay/equivalence behavior demonstrated.
